title: Enumeration of a circuit layer
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered circuit with Boolean-valued gates, input set $	ext{Fin}\,n$, and a singleton output, using only the standard gate operations. For every natural number $m$ with $m < 	ext{depth}(F)+1$, the nodes in layer $m$ are in bijection with the natural numbers less than the number of nodes in that layer.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ uses only the standard gate operations
